title: Fem 3D Stacked Concrete Forest Example
description: Add a `concrete-forest` example to the fem3d artifact (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🏗️fem/🗿️artifacts/🧊️3d): two Hexagonal Cut Concrete Forest Left pieces stacked on top of each other, modelled with nodes and line (frame) elements only. Member topology follows the CAD structure-classic representation (two hexagonal columns, seven cantilever beams, one spine beam, slab as tributary member loads); node coordinates are the puzzle3d Concrete Forest vortex (connection point) coordinates so the upper piece's c-b vortices land exactly on the lower piece's c-t vortices. Solve the deformation (self weight + slab dead + live, ULS/SLS combinations) and prove it with the engine, an independent numpy oracle, and the React lane. Bookkeeping is manual on disk because the repo MCP failed to connect.
note: Ticket bookkeeping done manually on disk: repo MCP failed to connect (connect timeout) for the whole session.
summary: fem3d ships a `concrete-forest` example: two Hexagonal Cut Concrete Forest Left pieces stacked (lower z 0→3, upper z 3→6) as 20 nodes + 20 frame elements only. Member topology mirrors the CAD play fixture's `aec.building.structure.classic` model (two hexagonal columns, seven cantilevers, one spine per piece; the one-way slab as tributary member UDLs), node coordinates are the puzzle3d Concrete Forest vortices verbatim so the upper piece's c-b vortices land on the lower c-t vortices (shared head joints). Sections from the `aec.building` solids (hex R 0.30, beams 0.30×0.45), C30/37, dead (self weight + 10 298 N/m) and live (4 952 N/m) cases, ULS/SLS combinations. Registered in the crate `examples` module, subset `examples()`, `setActiveExample` (id match) and the palette select; descriptor pair + registry regenerated. Deformation: `fem3d_solve_all` agrees with an independent numpy 3D-frame oracle on all 20 nodes (3.1e-7 relative), reactions balance the loads, every cantilever's sag beyond its head's rigid motion is exactly wL⁴/8EI, the asymmetric cut leans the heads apart in y (upper ±4.94 mm) and lifts the light-side tips; SLS peak −5.94 mm at uv4, ULS −8.26 mm. Proven by example tests (3/3), set-active-example tests (20/20), fem-js vitest (8/8) and on the React lane (6087): combobox switch dispatches setActiveExample nodes=20 elements=20, results window re-solves and its node instances sit at model + 300 × dead displacement (2.5e-15 m vs oracle). Left open: the mounted live_visual lane refuses the model with its 40-equation modal cap (`fem3d.numerical-modal-order`), as it refuses the demo.
